constraint_hints: Prefer refactoring inside the existing method body and preserve the externally visible signature when possible.

New helpers should default to private methods unless the contract explicitly requires broader visibility.
Any touched async method must use an Async suffix and a Task/Task<T> return type.
Do not keep async on helpers or methods that no longer contain a real await.
For S3776, keep the externally visible API stable unless the plan explicitly provides verified propagation targets.
Retry downgrade: new helpers and extracted phases must stay synchronous unless their bodies contain a real await.
